mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_date_trigger_state WHERE deleted = 0 AND application_id = #{app} ORDER BY application_id, resource_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_date_trigger_state(application_id, resource_id, armed, closed_date, armed_at, creator, updater) VALUES (#{app}, #{resource}, true, #{closed}, clock_timestamp(), #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(application_id, resource_id) DO UPDATE SET armed = true, closed_date = EXCLUDED.closed_date, armed_at = clock_timestamp(), last_error = NULL, deleted = 0, updater = EXCLUDED.updater, update_time = clock_timestamp() WHERE public.nocode_date_trigger_state.armed = false OR public.nocode_date_trigger_state.deleted = 1

INSERT INTO public.nocode_date_trigger_done(application_id, resource_id, business_date, source_record_id, outcome, creator, updater) VALUES (#{app}, #{resource}, #{date}, #{source}, 'RUNNING', #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(application_id, resource_id, business_date, source_record_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public.nocode_date_trigger_done(application_id, resource_id, business_date, source_record_id, outcome, message, creator, updater) VALUES (#{app}, #{resource}, #{date}, #{source}, 'FAILED', #{message}, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(application_id, resource_id, business_date, source_record_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT creator FROM public.nocode_application WHERE id = #{app}
